prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: visual design proposal for a real Snabbit starter-pack level map, level 5, named Twin Moon Garden.
Input images: Image 1 is the actual game's sprite and chunky stone-lever reference; Image 2 is the first level of each of the three original packs and defines the floating asteroid, breathing-space, and glowing collectible visual language. Use these as style references only, not as layouts to copy.
Primary request: Suggest one beautiful authored, playful short finale map, top-down/flat orthographic, whole playable level visible, upward travel from bottom to top. The map must be composed from discrete small faceted asteroid sprites on an invisible 16-column staggered hex lattice, 66 rows tall. Compose two substantial offset crescent-shaped asteroid islands, a pale silver crescent low on the left opening toward the middle, and a grey-white crescent high on the right opening toward the middle. They should be asymmetrical and different in shape, with natural chipped silhouettes, tiny satellites, and generous dark-blue negative space flowing between them. Give the image a graceful diagonal visual conversation and distinct beginning, middle, end.
Gameplay composition: At the bottom a clear open arrival and one little cyan gemstone lure lead toward a chunky stone lever just outside the lower crescent's open mouth. A short localized three-stone gate at that crescent's mouth opens a sheltered gold star pocket; the gate is small and visibly part of the island. A handful of cyan jewels suggest a smooth ascending arc through the airy middle to a second chunky stone lever near the left shoulder of the upper crescent. Its little diagonal gate opens another gold star pocket inside that crescent. A third gold star floats in a generous clear space above the islands. Include a small optional bright white diamond nook behind a tiny rock spur to create a surprising choice, reachable by a gentle detour. Finish above this with a short delicate cyan finish mark between two small asteroid tufts. There are exactly three stars, exactly two levers, two localized small gate sets. Levers should be recognizably stone toggle devices from reference, with orange handle (unflipped), not buttons, text, or geometric discs.
Style: faithful crisp polished 2D game sprites, pale chunky low-poly asteroid stones, gold stars, cyan gems, all on uniform midnight navy. Individual cells remain visible; no enclosing walls. Use tasteful variation in stone size and orientation while preserving the staggered grid. A legible level design with visual mass and flowing negative space, not merely decorative starry background.
Constraints: no roads, no full-width gate bands, no corridors made of parallel rails, no repeated zigzag, no repeated obstacle modules, no symmetry, no maze, no labels, no typography, no arrows, no HUD, no oversized character, no rectangular frames. No painted planets or huge free-form boulders: islands consist entirely of the small discrete sprite stones. Show row zero at the bottom. Portrait composition, all islands and finish fully visible.
